job.job_title: Databricks Engineer - Databricks Genie & Snowflake CoCo
job.job_description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Databricks Engineer / Data Engineer with strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Snowflake. The ideal candidate should have experience building and optimizing scalable data pipelines and working with modern cloud data platforms.

Exposure to Databricks Genie and Snowflake CoCo is preferred. Candidates without hands-on experience in these tools can also be considered if they demonstrate strong fundamentals, a positive attitude, and willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, PySpark, and SQL.
Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes for large-scale data processing.
Work extensively with Apache Spark / PySpark for data transformation and processing.
Develop complex and optimized SQL queries, stored procedures, and data transformations.
Work with Snowflake for data warehousing, data loading, transformation, and performance optimization.
Integrate Databricks with Snowflake and other enterprise data sources.
Implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Troubleshoot production data pipeline issues and ensure reliable data processing.
Collaborate with data engineers, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders.
Explore and leverage AI-powered capabilities such as Databricks Genie and Snowflake CoCo where applicable.

Mandatory Skills

Databricks
PySpark
SQL
Snowflake
Apache Spark
ETL / ELT
Data Engineering concepts
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Good to Have

Databricks Genie experience or knowledge
Snowflake CoCo experience or knowledge
Experience integrating Databricks and Snowflake
Delta Lake
Databricks Workflows / Jobs
Cloud platforms such as Azure / AWS / GCP
Data pipeline optimization and performance tuning
AI/GenAI-assisted data engineering capabilities

Candidate Profile

We are looking for candidates who:

Have strong practical experience in Databricks + PySpark + SQL + Snowflake.
Understand data engineering and distributed data processing concepts.
Can independently develop, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines.
Have exposure to Databricks Genie and/or Snowflake CoCo OR are willing and capable of learning these technologies quickly.
Demonstrate a strong learning mindset and adaptability to new tools and technologies.

Key Search Keywords

Databricks | PySpark | SQL | Snowflake | Apache Spark | Databricks Genie | Snowflake CoCo | Delta Lake | ETL | ELT | Data Engineering | Data Pipelines | Data Warehouse
